title: Irrigation for Depopulated Rural Areas in Mediterranean Climate: Surveying the Population
content: Rural depopulation is related to several socio-economic variables, including services, transport, communication and employment, among others. This paper assesses the influence of irrigation systems as population fixers in rural municipalities. For this purpose, a national survey was carried out in which the inhabitants of rural municipalities were asked about relevant aspects of depopulation in relation to the presence of irrigation systems in the area. A questionnaire was drawn up, based on expert judgement, containing 45 questions with dichotomous and Likert type answers. The answers were analysed by studying the dependence of the answers on the presence of irrigation systems in the areas surveyed. The results show that rural dwellers are satisfied with life in rural areas, giving greater importance to health and education services, access to the Internet, job opportunities and transport. It is observed that irrigation is perceived as a positive element in both irrigated and non-irrigated municipalities.
